scope: Authorized FOMC source/coverage audit, policy-information shock decomposition and matched timing comparison; no changes to previous research outputs
events: USMPD Statements; scheduled meetings primary (Unscheduled==0), exact Eastern announcement timestamp converted with America/New_York DST
shock_primary: Authors' maintained jkshocks_update_fed MP_median and CBI_median, exact announcement date-time match; no proxy substitution when unavailable
decomposition: Reproduce author's signrestr_median on published pc1 and sp500 over the author's full complete sample, w=0.5; sensitivity w=0.1,0.9 on the same calibration sample
shock_units: Components in percentage points of the published policy indicator; multiply by10 for coefficients per +10bps contribution to pc1. Not STMT, FF3 or a pure observed Fed rate change
boundary: Coinbase USD minute close immediately before each boundary; require all31 endpoint-inclusive candles, no interpolation
daily_source: Download Coinbase BTC-USD/ETH-USD 86400-second candles into separate immutable cache; same exchange and USD quote as intraday, complete UTC-day labels; never splice into frozen Coin Metrics history
outcomes: Intraday [-10,+20], full event UTC-day return, post-event D+1..D+h for h=1..30, all percent log returns
primary_membership: Joint BTC/ETH intersection of scheduled events with exact author timestamp, finite two shocks, complete intraday, Coinbase daily outcomes through h30 and fixed prior controls; same events for all32 outcomes and both assets
controls: Per asset Coinbase return D-2, trailing30 daily RMS annualized ending D-2, and frozen calendar-information prior VIX proxy; same controls for every timing outcome
inference: OLS with intercept and both shock components jointly; HAC5 finite correction on chronological event rows, approximate normal pointwise95% intervals; conditional on generated shock series, not full two-stage/posterior uncertainty
families: Primary full:128 coefficients (2assets*32outcomes*2shocks), BH together. Pre/post fits separately reported, BH over256 possible tests with missing/insufficient cells treated p=1. Rotation sensitivities descriptive, no selection by p-values
identification_sensitivity: All eligible rotation coefficients saved at w=0.1,0.5,0.9; ranges are not confidence intervals; covariance/PC-calibration uncertainty is not covered
timing_differences: Fit outcome differences on identical X to obtain direct intraday versus event-day/post7 slope differences with covariance; separate BH8 tests, not comparing p-values from separate windows
daily_coverage_sensitivity: Repeat full daily/event and post-h fits on all eligible per-asset daily events without intraday membership; compare sample counts and point estimates descriptively
interpretation: Application of published high-frequency sign-restricted shock series to crypto, not a replication of JK2020 monthly Bayesian VAR. Causal interpretation remains conditional on no confounding announcement-window news, sign restrictions and external validity; VIX/USD causality untouched
preserve: All old data/models/outputs/ZIPs and prospective protocol remain unchanged; no scheduler, new forecasting model or stress threshold change
